sync.description: Manage the current connection and full local article history.

webdav.title: WebDAV data sync
webdav.description: Upload this client's reading events in monthly files and combine events read from other ReadFlux clients.
webdav.neverSynced: Not synced yet. Credentials are stored in plain text in this browser; events are plain JSON on WebDAV.
webdav.disconnected: WebDAV disconnected; server data was kept
webdav.missingFields: Enter the WebDAV URL and client name

recommendation.title: Local recommendation profile
recommendation.description: This shows raw reading events from this browser and WebDAV mirrors, plus weights derived from them and Miniflux saved articles. Scores are still used only to order Today.
recommendation.exportHint: The export is a local unencrypted file with reading events, ranking exposures, derived weights, and titles and excerpts of related articles. It never contains Miniflux or WebDAV credentials.
recommendation.webDavSyncing: WebDAV is syncing. Export will be available when sync finishes.
recommendation.webDavLastSynced: WebDAV last synced: {{time}}. The export includes mirrored events from other clients.
recommendation.webDavNeverSynced: WebDAV has not synced yet. The export includes only this browser's events.
recommendation.webDavExportStale: The export uses the last successfully mirrored WebDAV data.
recommendation.sourceWeightsHint: Smoothed reading depth (with diminishing credit for saved articles) × position-adjusted Today open rate, relative to the average feed, with time decay
recommendation.sourceAffinityDetail: Depth {{engagement}}% over {{reads}} reads · {{opens}} opens / {{impressions}} impressions → open rate ×{{openRate}} average · {{stars}} saved (+{{starWeight}})
recommendation.positiveTermsHint: Only candidate topics you actively select receive weight
recommendation.editorHint: Scroll depth uses 0–1; separate keywords with commas.
recommendation.missingFields: Enter an article title and source
recommendation.reasonTerms: This article matches topics you explicitly selected: “{{terms}}”.
recommendation.reasonSaved: You saved this article in Miniflux.
recommendation.reasonCategory: From “{{category}}”, ranked using publication time and your local interest profile.
recommendation.reasonNew: Your interest profile is still light. Recommendations will personalize as you read.
recommendation.feedbackQuestion: Does this article match your interests?
recommendation.reduced: Not interested recorded for this article without inferring negative topics
recommendation.reinforced: This kind of content will be recommended more
recommendation.candidateTopicsHint: They affect recommendations only after you select them
recommendation.extractingTopics: Extracting in the background without blocking reading…

connect.headline:
Turn Miniflux into
your personal intelligence reader.
connect.lead: Articles come from Miniflux. Reading behavior stays in this browser by default and can optionally sync between ReadFlux clients through your WebDAV.
connect.keyBoundary: ● The key only goes between this browser and Miniflux
connect.directFailed: The browser cannot connect directly. Check HTTPS, the URL, and whether the reverse proxy allows CORS and X-Auth-Token.

feed.syncingHint: Unread articles appear first, followed by saved and read articles.
feed.emptyHint: Choose another feed or show all articles.
feed.noUnread: The current list has no unread articles
feed.noSummary: This article does not have a summary yet.

reader.selectHint: Reading behavior starts shaping Today only after you open an article.

meta.description: ReadFlux is a local-first RSS client that connects to Miniflux and learns reading preferences in the browser.

ai.errorProvider: The AI provider reported an error. {{detail}}
ai.errorRefusal: The AI provider declined to process this article.
ai.errorEmpty: The AI provider returned no text for this article.

ai.modelHint: Type a model name, or load the list from the base URL.

ai.modelsAvailable_other: {{count}} models available. Pick from the suggestions or type a name.
ai.modelsEmpty: The provider returned no models. Type the model name instead.
ai.modelsUnavailable: This endpoint doesn't list models. Type the model name instead.
ai.baseURLHintOpenAI: Any OpenAI-compatible chat completions endpoint, such as OpenAI, OpenRouter, DeepSeek, Ollama, or LM Studio. Local servers must allow this site's origin.

ai.apiKeyHint: Stored unencrypted in this browser's localStorage and sent only to this provider.

ai.disconnectConfirm: Remove the AI provider settings and all saved summaries and translations from this browser?
ai.translationDescription: The language used by the Translate button and the Summary panel.
ai.targetLanguageHint: Summaries are written in this language too.

ai.clearResultsConfirm: Delete all saved summaries and translations from this browser?

ai.privacyKey: Your API key is stored unencrypted in this browser and sent only to that provider.
